A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have derived an exact expression for a four-point function in a quantum field theory with a non-trivial spectrum and that we have shown that the usual criticism against the method of quantum affine algebra is unfounded.
we provide an explicit series expansion for the exact four-spinon contribution, which can be used as a benchmark for approximate calculations.

the exact four-spinon correlation function of the isotropic Heisenberg model is given by a sum of three terms: the first term is an infinite series of terms, each of which has the structure of the two-spinon correlation function; the second term is a sum over the roots of a cubic equation, which is the exact four-spin correlation function of a certain integrable model; the third term is the four-spinon correlation functions of a certain integrabale model with a free fermion spectrum
The main takeaway from our work is that
the exact four-spinon contribution is not exponentially small, contrary to what is usually believed.
the exact diagonalization in the thermodynamic regime is not only possible but also very useful for the computation of dynamical correlation functions.
the four-spinon dynamcialal correlation function is a smooth, non-singular function of the energy and momentum.
